description: Deterministic native Page Builder content composer (G3 issue #23, G4 issue #25): composes persisted master-format HTML from a pinned NodeIR/PageStructure/registry/manifest — pure computation, no filesystem, no network, no write operations. Composes exactly TWO bounded section shapes, detected per section and driven by explicit role evidence, never guessed: the hero shape (full-width background media + overlaid text + CTA) as native row(contained) > banner(poster), and the two-column shape (one column-primary + one column-secondary projected slot container) as the declaration-backed chain row(contained) > column-group(default) > column-line > column(full-height) x2 with role-resolved text folded into a text(default) WYSIWYG and projected inline-media slots as image(full-width) elements — column-line is the declaration-mandated bridge and observed side-by-side media pairs compose stacked with explicit fidelity gaps (nesting a column-group inside a column violates the pinned policies). Native targets are verified against the pinned registry first; every planned source node is accounted for in the mapping (mapped / gap / decoration-merged / excluded / skipped); missing content inputs and non-representable arrangements come back as NOT_VERIFIED gap warnings — never invented around, never embedded as arbitrary HTML. Structural composition evidence only: no Admin round-trip or visual claim.
